headline: Amber Enterprises India Limited: Acquisition
sum: Acquisition — Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations 2015 we wish to inform the Exchange that the timeline for completion of the second tranche of acquisition of equity stake in MoMagic Wireless Private Limited by IL JIN…
detail: Acquisition — Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations 2015 we wish to inform the Exchange that the timeline for completion of the second tranche of acquisition of equity stake in MoMagic Wireless Private Limited by IL JIN Electronics India Private Limited a material subsidiary of the Company has been extended to 30th September 2026 or such other date as mutually agreed between the parties to the Definitive Transaction Agreements.
